name: hacknclash-root
description: Root workspace runner for HACK 'N' CLASH

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.vercel-build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
